statement: The sculpture park pathways are on one level and are suited to prams and wheelchairs, with seating positioned through the grounds.
note: First evidence in the accessibility class anywhere in this corpus. The Stage 1 seed drew zero rows for it. All three event records hedge with a variant of check with the venue for specific needs, while the operator and the regional body both publish a positive statement. The hedge is weaker than the evidence available, which is a different defect from being wrong. Authored by hand for the PI-005 Stage 2 pilot on the Pt. Leo Estate sculpture park cluster. Sources were read on 2026-09-13; see ops/reports/claims/2026-09-13-pilot-pt-leo-sculpture-park.md.
